correctness.rationale: Exact algebraic equalities imply one step of common-lower-bound graph expansion. In a shortest path of k stages from an upset, k initial vertices are nonminimal and k distinct minimal edge witnesses must be different from them; hence \(2k\leq n\). Explicit height-two fences achieve \(k=\lfloor n/2\rfloor\). The proof handles empty U, multiple components and n=1. Standard-library checker exhaustively tests the stated finite scope and every fence \(k\leq50\) but is not the infinite proof.
